response.sql: WITH order_avgs AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) as avg_fill FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(fillcount) as overall_avg FROM orderexecutions), first_filter AS (SELECT oa.ordersmark, oa.avg_fill, oa.avg_fill - oa2.overall_avg as margin_over_overall FROM order_avgs oa CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa2 WHERE oa.avg_fill > oa2.overall_avg), second_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill) as first_group_avg FROM first_filter), second_filter AS (SELECT ff.ordersmark, ff.avg_fill, ff.margin_over_overall, ff.avg_fill - sb.first_group_avg as margin_over_first_group FROM first_filter ff CROSS JOIN second_benchmark sb WHERE ff.avg_fill > sb.first_group_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_fill) as avg_fill_final, AVG(margin_over_overall) as avg_margin_over_overall, AVG(margin_over_first_group) as avg_margin_over_first_group FROM second_filter;
